title: Schedule of Member Copays, Medicaid Managed Care Membership
content:
The Medicaid Managed Care Membership sets one member copay per claim for each copay category of medical service, and the amount differs by eligibility category. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Copay per claim by eligibility category

| Copay category | Expansion Adult | Family Care | CHIP Kids | Children's Medicaid | Pregnancy Care | ABD Care | Dual Complete |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary care office visit | $2.00 | $2.00 | $5.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $1.00 | $0.00 |
| Specialist office visit | $3.00 | $3.00 | $10.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $2.00 | $0.00 |
| Outpatient behavioral health visit | $2.00 | $2.00 | $5.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $1.00 | $0.00 |
| Non-emergency visit to a hospital emergency room | $8.00 | $8.00 | $25.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $8.00 | $0.00 |
| Inpatient hospital stay (once per admission) | $75.00 | $50.00 | $100.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $25.00 | $0.00 |
| Outpatient hospital or ambulatory surgery | $3.00 | $3.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $2.00 | $0.00 |
| Laboratory or plain X-ray | $1.00 | $1.00 | $5.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $1.00 | $0.00 |
| Ground ambulance transport | $3.00 | $3.00 | $10.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $3.00 | $0.00 |

Every category name above is the Prairie Ridge category of that name (for example, "CHIP Kids" is Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids).

## Exemptions and conditions by eligibility category

| Term | Expansion Adult | Family Care | CHIP Kids | Children's Medicaid | Pregnancy Care | ABD Care | Dual Complete |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive and well-child claims carry no copay | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Family planning claims carry no copay | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Emergency room claims coded as a true emergency carry no copay | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A member with an active LTSS Service Coordination care enrollment on the service date pays no copay | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The non-emergency emergency-room copay may be charged only when the hospital screening found no emergency and offered an alternative provider | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- The inpatient copay is charged once per admission, not per day of the stay.
- Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid, Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care and Prairie Ridge Dual Complete carry a $0.00 copay in every copay category.
- The exemptions and the emergency-room screening condition hold identically in all seven categories.

## Hypothetical reading

*A hypothetical Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids member with one specialist visit claim, one laboratory claim and one ambulance claim* is scheduled for $10.00, $5.00 and $10.00 respectively; the same three claims for a Prairie Ridge ABD Care member are scheduled for $2.00, $1.00 and $3.00.
